calls.statement:
SELECT 
  campaign_id,
  campaign_name,
  start_date,
  end_date,
  mailing_list_size,
  holdout_size,
  holdout_pct
FROM dim_campaign
WHERE campaign_name LIKE '%Black Week%' OR campaign_name LIKE '%black week%'
